offworld-trading-company game sourced

Offworld Trading Company

A real-time economic strategy game on Mars where companies claim resource tiles, refine goods for a shared market whose prices move with every trade, and win by buying out every rival's stock.

2015Mohawk GamesBusiness / economic simcluster c0212 mechanics
this record asyaml sourcemarkdownjson

core loop

land an HQ -> claim tiles and build extractors -> refine resources into goods -> sell into a market whose prices move with each trade -> buy black market sabotage and stock -> buy out every rival

design notes

Soren Johnson replaced combat with a shared market: 13 resources trade at prices that move with every purchase and sale, so selling a large stockpile drives the price down and one player's bulk purchases create openings for others. Black market items such as nukes, EMPs, and mutinies act through the economy, and each purchase raises the price of the next one. Victory comes from equity: players buy shares in rivals until they hold a majority of every company, and buying back one's own shares makes a takeover more expensive. Johnson names M.U.L.E. and Railroad Tycoon as inspirations.

uses

Equity and buyouts

Players buy shares in rival companies and win by holding a majority of every company; debt lowers stock price, and buying back one's own stock raises buyout cost.

core
uses

Production chains

Steel mills, glass kilns, electronics factories, greenhouses, and hydrolysis reactors turn raw resources into higher-value goods and life support.

core
uses

Resource extraction

Extractors on claimed hex tiles mine water, aluminum, iron, silicon, and carbon at rates set by tile richness.

core
uses

Rival firms

Up to eight companies, AI or human, compete in one market and attack each other through black market sabotage such as nukes, EMPs, and mutinies.

core
uses

Supply-demand pricing

Each of 13 resources has a market price that falls when players sell and rises when they buy, with shortages and gluts driving rapid swings.

core
uses

Auctions

Some resource tiles and patents are sold by auction.

uses

uses

Goods consumption

Each HQ consumes life support resources such as water, food, oxygen, and power, which must be produced or bought.

supporting
uses

Loans and debt

Companies can run into debt, which depresses their share price.

supporting
uses

Procedural terrain
